key_insight: The paper introduces a fully discrete, symmetric N-phase Navier--Stokes--Cahn--Hilliard scheme that preserves thermodynamic structure, conservation laws, and energy dissipation for arbitrary density ratios.
engineering_relevance: This gives multiphase-flow simulators a robust framework for modeling incompressible mixtures with many phases without sacrificing physical consistency or symmetry.
method: Symmetric treatment of all phases with arbitrary density ratios
Built-in conservation of phase volume, phase mass, total volume, total mass, and discrete energy dissipation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical verification of the structure-preserving properties and robustness on representative multiphase flow problems.
watch_item: Practical implementation may be challenging because the scheme must enforce the saturation constraint and preserve multiple discrete invariants simultaneously.
paper_title: Symmetric structure-preserving discretization of N-phase incompressible fluid mixtures with arbitrary density ratios
